title: agentshark portable trace (.aspark) v1
description: Versioned JSON schema for a single exported agent session. Used by `agentshark export`, `agentshark --replay`, and as a bug-report attachment format. Locked: changes require a major version bump (.aspark v2).

asparkVersion.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes.

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this file was produced.

exportedBy.description: Tool + version that produced the file, e.g. 'agentshark@0.1.2'.

redaction.description: Summary of redaction that was applied before export. Required so a viewer can disclose what was scrubbed.

policy.description: Built-in redaction policy name. 'custom' indicates the user supplied a .agentshark-redact config.

patternsApplied.description: Names of pattern matchers that ran (e.g. 'aws_access_key_id', 'jwt', 'env_token').

matchCount.description: Total number of redaction substitutions performed.

customPatterns.description: Project-specific regex patterns, if any, sourced from .agentshark-redact.

session.description: Metadata about the single agent session this trace represents.

totals.description: Pre-aggregated session totals for quick rendering.

traceId.description: Multi-agent run identifier. Session UUID for this session.

spanId.description: Unique identifier for this event within the trace.

parentSpanId.description: If this event is nested (e.g. sub-agent inside orchestrator), the parent span's id.

subtype.description: Type-specific specialiser, e.g. 'user'/'assistant' for message, 'pre_tool'/'post_tool' for hook.

tokensIn.description: Cache-aware input token attribution. Input only — output is reported per-turn on api_turn events.

cacheState.description: Cache classification for the bucket this event was attributed to.

durationApproxMs.description: Duration in milliseconds. Real for SDK-emitted events; approximate (derived from consecutive entry timestamps) for file-tailed events.

payload.description: Full event-specific payload after redaction. Shape varies by type. NEVER carries unredacted secret content.

tags.description: Arbitrary string tags for filtering (mcp_server, hook_name, tool_name, file_path, host, env, ...).

category.description: Internal category bucket used by the Context Composition view.
